design.interpretation: Gold support titles make these oracle diagnostics, not an achievable retriever or proof of internal model reasoning. Page presence is not verified textual sufficiency. Exact match can reject valid answers; Study 2 human audit remains essential.
design.missing_page: On every partial question, compare a fresh unchanged top-10 replay with a prompt that replaces the lowest-ranked non-support page with the missing annotated support page at the same position.
design.pilot: Two partial and two complete questions from the separate Study 2 pilot set, both arms each, for technical validation only.
design.present_page_cue: On every complete question, compare two fresh prompts with identical ten pages and cue instructions; all passage focus flags are zero in control, and exactly the two annotated support-page flags become one in intervention.
design.primary_outcomes: Within-question intervention-minus-control official HotpotQA exact match difference for each experiment, with repairs, harms, paired bootstrap 95% intervals, and exact two-sided discordant-pair p-values.
design.secondary_outcomes: Within-question F1 difference, response-integrity counts, and comparison to the original Study 2 answers as descriptive context only.

bm25.tokenizer: Unicode NFKC casefold; regex [^\W_]+; no stopword removal or stemming

model_configuration.retrieval_unit: one merged page-introduction unit per normalized Wikipedia title

population: The frozen 200 Study 2 main questions: 91 partial and 106 complete; three with neither support page are excluded from these interventions.
scientific_question: How much do missing support-page access and cues to already retrieved support pages change answer quality?
